findings.detail: issuer_name contains concatenated schedule context and loan terms; the source keeps issuer in the Investments column and terms in separate columns.

rationale: C206 is confirmed. In the raw investment schedule, rows such as table 10 row 5 have a clean issuer cell, R1 Holdings, LLC (f), with Type, Reference Rate and Spread, Interest Rate, and Maturity Date in separate columns; surrounding category rows provide investment classification separately. The extracted issuer_name instead concatenates investment hierarchy, industry, issuer, type, rate, interest rate, and maturity into one issuer field. Table 11 row 3 shows the same schedule structure on another flagged position. This is a localized issuer_name parse/extraction defect, not a check defect.
